name: Bound By Fate ~ Cursed Soulmates ~
source:
After a major car accident, you start to see a red string - connecting you to a gorgeous man who claims to be your soulmate. 

The only problem? You've never met this man, and he does NOT seem content to leave things be. Can you break free from his obsession? Or will you accept this "destined love"? 

[From [url=https://bigmamafatcat.itch.io/bound-by-fate-cursed-soulmates]itch.io[/url]]
